## Checklist

- [ ] Scoped to one roadmap item
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] No changes to %1RM/e1RM logic, webhook payload shapes, or generated app/src/data/playbook.js (unless the item explicitly allows it)
- [ ] Session docs (STATUS.md / docs/handoff.md) updated if this closes a session
- [ ] If this changes anything a user can see: the matching Guide article (and What's new) is updated in this PR, or the description says why none applies
